message.content: {"note_claim": "The video shows the 2022 Kerch (Crimean) Bridge explosion, not the King Fahd Bridge.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "CCTV footage appears to show the moment the bridge linking Crimea and Russia was hit by a huge explosion early on Saturday morning.", "reason": "The Guardian page presents CCTV video of the October 2022 Kerch bridge explosion, substantiating that such footage exists and depicts that event, though it does not mention King Fahd Bridge."}

parsed.note_claim: The video shows the 2022 Kerch (Crimean) Bridge explosion, not the King Fahd Bridge.

parsed.quote: CCTV footage appears to show the moment the bridge linking Crimea and Russia was hit by a huge explosion early on Saturday morning.
